# The cases of magic-trackpad-battery: a fake sysfs and /dev, the answers the
# hidraw nodes give, the arguments, and what the command prints. The Odin
# tests (tests/cases_test.odin) run every case, and so did a harness against
# the Python tool this one replaces: every case without a "new:" line passed
# on the Python first, which is how the port was held to its behavior.
#
#   case: NAME           starts a case
#   new:                 the Python never handled this; Odin only
#   args: ARG...         the arguments (default: none)
#   dev: ID | DRIVER | MODELS | UEVENT | NODES
#                        a HID device in /sys/bus/hid/devices. DRIVER is the
#                        name its driver link points to. MODELS is the
#                        power_supply directories (ps0, ps1 ...) separated by
#                        ";": the text of the model_name file, or "!" for a
#                        directory with no model_name, "@" for one whose
#                        model_name is a directory. UEVENT is the file's
#                        text. NODES are the hidraw nodes, separated by ",".
#                        "-" leaves a field out.
#   node: NAME ANSWER    what /dev/NAME gives: three hex bytes, optionally
#                        followed by ret=N (the ioctl's return value, 3 by
#                        default); "denied" (cannot be opened); "fail" (opens,
#                        and the ioctl fails)
#   out: LINE            a line of standard output, in order
#
# \n, \t, \xNN and \\ are escapes in dev fields and out lines.

case: a full battery reads 100 percent, as the kernel does not (it says 4)
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad\n | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 04 64
out: Magic Trackpad: 100% (discharging)

case: --tsv is capacity, status and name, separated by tabs
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad\n | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 04 64
out: 100\tDischarging\tMagic Trackpad

case: bit 1 of the flags byte is charging
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad\n | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 02 37
out: Magic Trackpad: 55% (charging)

case: the other bits of the flags byte do not count
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 FD 50
out: Magic Trackpad: 80% (discharging)

case: all the other bits and the charging bit set is charging
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 FF 50
out: 80\tCharging\tMagic Trackpad

case: an empty battery is 0 percent
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 00
out: 0\tDischarging\tMagic Trackpad

case: a capacity of exactly 100 is kept and 101 is no answer
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Hundred | - | hidraw3
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0002 | magicmouse | Over | - | hidraw4
node: hidraw3 90 00 64
node: hidraw4 90 00 65
out: 100\tDischarging\tHundred

case: a capacity of 255 is no answer
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 FF

case: a report that is not 0x90 is no answer
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 91 00 32

case: a node that cannot be opened is no answer
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 denied

case: a node that does not exist is no answer
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3

case: a node whose ioctl fails is no answer
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 fail

case: a device with no hidraw directory is no answer
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | -

case: with several nodes the first one that answers is used
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Two Nodes | - | hidraw7,hidraw8
node: hidraw7 denied
node: hidraw8 90 00 2A
out: 42\tDischarging\tTwo Nodes

case: a node that answers with another report id does not stop the next one
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Two Nodes | - | hidraw7,hidraw8
node: hidraw7 91 00 05
node: hidraw8 90 02 2A
out: 42\tCharging\tTwo Nodes

case: the first node that answers wins when both do
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Two Nodes | - | hidraw7,hidraw8
node: hidraw7 90 00 0A
node: hidraw8 90 00 14
out: 10\tDischarging\tTwo Nodes

case: nodes are tried in name order, not in number order
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Ten | - | hidraw9,hidraw10
node: hidraw9 90 00 09
node: hidraw10 90 00 0A
out: 10\tDischarging\tTen

case: devices are picked by driver, whatever their name
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
dev: 0003:046D:C52B.0003 | hid-generic | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw5
dev: 0003:0000:0000.0004 | - | Magic Mouse | - | hidraw6
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
node: hidraw5 90 00 33
node: hidraw6 90 00 34
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic Trackpad

case: devices are listed in the order of their names
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0010 | magicmouse | Second | - | hidraw3
dev: 0003:05AC:0324.0002 | magicmouse | Third | - | hidraw4
dev: 0003:05AC:0324.0001 | magicmouse | First | - | hidraw5
node: hidraw3 90 00 01
node: hidraw4 90 00 02
node: hidraw5 90 00 03
out: 3\tDischarging\tFirst
out: 2\tDischarging\tThird
out: 1\tDischarging\tSecond

case: a device that cannot be read is left out and the others are printed
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Gone | - | hidraw3
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0002 | magicmouse | Here | - | hidraw4
node: hidraw3 denied
node: hidraw4 90 00 5A
out: 90\tDischarging\tHere

case: the label is the power_supply model, stripped
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | \n  Magic Trackpad  \n | HID_NAME=Other\n | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic Trackpad

case: without a power_supply the label is the HID_NAME of the uevent
args: --tsv
dev: 0003:05AC:0324.0002 | magicmouse | - | DRIVER=magicmouse\nHID_NAME=Magic Keyboard\nHID_ID=0003\n | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic Keyboard

case: the last HID_NAME of the uevent wins
args: --tsv
dev: 0003:05AC:0324.0002 | magicmouse | - | HID_NAME=First\nHID_NAME=Second\n | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tSecond

case: a HID_NAME with an equals sign keeps everything after the first
args: --tsv
dev: 0003:05AC:0324.0002 | magicmouse | - | HID_NAME=A=B\n | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tA=B

case: with neither a model nor a uevent the label is Magic device
args: --tsv
dev: 0003:05AC:0324.0002 | magicmouse | - | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic device

case: an empty model leaves the default label and the uevent is not read then
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | \n | HID_NAME=never read\n | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic device

case: a uevent without a HID_NAME leaves the default label
args: --tsv
dev: 0003:05AC:0324.0002 | magicmouse | - | DRIVER=magicmouse\nMODALIAS=hid\n | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic device

case: a power_supply directory without model_name is skipped for the next
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | !;Second Supply;Third Supply | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tSecond Supply

case: only power_supply directories without model_name leave the default label
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | ! | HID_NAME=never read\n | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic device

case: the first power_supply with a model_name wins even when the model is empty
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | \n;Second Supply | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic device

case: no device prints nothing
args: --tsv

case: no device prints nothing in the text format

case: an argument it does not know is ignored
args: --bogus --tsv extra
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic Trackpad

case: the text format has the state in lower case
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0002 | magicmouse | Magic Mouse | - | hidraw4
node: hidraw3 90 02 0A
node: hidraw4 90 00 0B
out: Magic Trackpad: 10% (charging)
out: Magic Mouse: 11% (discharging)

# What the Python never handled.

case: an empty HID_NAME leaves the default label
new:
args: --tsv
dev: 0003:05AC:0324.0002 | magicmouse | - | HID_NAME=\n | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic device

case: a name's control characters become spaces, so a tab cannot split a field
new:
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic\tTrackpad\r\x1b[31m | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic Trackpad  [31m

case: a name that is not UTF-8 shows the replacement character
new:
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic \xff\xfeTrackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tMagic \xef\xbf\xbd\xef\xbf\xbdTrackpad

case: a model_name that is a directory is skipped for the next
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | @;Second Supply | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32
out: 50\tDischarging\tSecond Supply

case: a short ioctl is no answer, whatever the buffer holds
new:
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32 ret=2

case: an ioctl that returns nothing is no answer
new:
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Magic Trackpad | - | hidraw3
node: hidraw3 90 00 32 ret=0

case: a short ioctl on one node leaves the next to answer
new:
args: --tsv
dev: 0005:004C:0324.0001 | magicmouse | Two Nodes | - | hidraw7,hidraw8
node: hidraw7 90 00 05 ret=1
node: hidraw8 90 00 2A
out: 42\tDischarging\tTwo Nodes
